title: Voyager 1 Now a Full Light-Day Away from Earth
body: The Voyager 1 probe has reached a distance of a full light-day from Earth, meaning its signals now take 24 hours to reach us — and 48 hours for a round trip.
Simply put: a light-day is the distance light travels in a full day; Voyager 1 launched in 1977 and is still sending us signals from the farthest point any human-made object has ever reached.
Can you imagine a message from a spacecraft taking a whole day to arrive?
